newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine telecom firms to sign transmission pact.
newsitem.headline: Philippine telecom firms to sign transmission pact.

text.p: A consortium of nine local telecom companies will sign an agreement on Thursday to put up a nationwide telecommunications transmission network estimated to cost from $100 million to $120 million, National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) head Simeon Kintanar said.

Kintanar told Reuters the Telecommunications Infrastructure Corporation of the Philippines (Telicphil) will sign an agreement for the construction, operation and maintenance of a national digital transmission network, an alternative to the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co's existing nationwide network.

Members of the Telicphil consortium are Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc, Express Telecommunications Co Inc, Digital Telecommunications Philippines Inc, Globe GMCR Inc, ICC Telecoms, Isla Communications Co Inc, Philippine Global Communications Inc, Philippine Telephone & Telegraph Corp and Smart Communications Co Inc.
